bio.text: David Graham, a Libertarian from Overland Park, is a candidate for U.S. Senate in Kansas in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Republican Sen. Roger Marshall and Democrat Adam Hamilton.
He was the Libertarian Party's candidate for U.S. Senate in 2022, running against Sen. Jerry Moran.

sources.title: Roger Marshall wins GOP primary; Adam Hamilton to represent Democrats in Kansas Senate race
